items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Elvin Jones came through in a band he had with Andrew White and Ari Brown

ctx.x: Was there this thought in your mind that eventually I’m going to go to New York City?

Yeah pretty much. I knew that I would eventually have to go to New York to pursue the music, I mean once my love for the music really developed while I was in college. Because we had people coming through all the time. We had — my first week of school Elvin Jones came through in a band he had with Andrew White and Ari Brown. Sonny Rollins came through a couple of years later, and people like Frank Foster, Jackie Byard, the Heath Brothers, they all came in for a week residency. Benny Carter also came in. And all…
Did you arrive with any contacts in place?
